justification: All share the common machinery of Fourier analysis on Euclidean space: restriction, Kakeya, Carleson, LlogL, Riesz transform, Bochner-Riesz, local smoothing
Convex body inequalities and symmetrization in R^n: Brunn-Minkowski, Mahler, Petty, Lax, Bang, slicing; the logarithmic endpoint unifies the Lp hierarchy
Shared machinery of geometric group theory: hyperbolicity, amenability, classifying spaces, quasi-isometry, CAT(0) actions; each resolves a named conjecture about group structure
The C*-algebra and von Neumann algebra classification program: Z-stability, trace cones, bicentralizers, paving, pure infiniteness, free entropy, generator problems
Chromatic filtration, Morava E-theory, finite spectra: Smith-Toda complexes, Kervaire invariant, K(n)-local finiteness, chromatic splitting, Hahn-Wilson
Critical random systems and conformal limits: LQG, percolation, spin models, SLE, GFF, Kesten-Stigum, factor of IID, random matrices; all resolve scaling-limit universality
Quantum information and its intersection with computational complexity: area law, MUBs, entanglement, QMA-hardness, quantum circuits, QAOA, quantum channels
Sharp thresholds and asymptotics in extremal combinatorics: Ramsey numbers with exact logarithmic exponents, expectation thresholds, containment thresholds, sharp-threshold widths
Commutative algebra and homological algebra: Serre intersection multiplicity, Lech multiplicity, Cohen-Macaulay modules, finitistic dimension, Auslander-Reiten, lex-plus-powers, Gersten
Riemannian geometry with curvature hypotheses: isometric immersions, scalar curvature and simplicial volume, width, Cartan-Hadamard isoperimetry, Yau, Katok, Blaschke, geodesics
